modifications: Upstream application logic and archive are unchanged. The static server replaces fixed remote script URLs in the example HTML with the bundled vendor paths.
configuration: The mode-switch example is served at /. The static allowlist excludes the advanced autocomplete, custom query-language and new-window examples. A Content Security Policy limits scripts to shipped assets and fixed example script hashes. No server-side persistent state is required.
